# Missed Call Text-Back: send one polite text to every caller you miss

> Free, open-source (MIT) missed-call text-back for contractors and local service businesses: a calculator for what unanswered calls cost, a message checker, and a self-host Twilio agent (one text per caller per 24 hours, quiet hours, STOP/START/HELP, signed webhooks). Results are estimates from numbers you type, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [Calculator and message check](https://marisstella.app/missed-call-textback/)
- [Guide for contractors](https://marisstella.app/missed-call-textback/missed-call-text-back-for-contractors.html)

## Source

- [Source and README](https://github.com/duncan-haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/missed-call-textback): MIT licensed. Tested against a fake Twilio only; no real call yet.
